Overview

Mytilene is a city in North Aegean with a population of 57,872. Lesbos’ capital with a stunning harbor, petrified forest, ouzo distilleries, and rich literary heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
